title: Brief decides the mechanism, not the outcome
objective: `com.smac.utils.DateUtil.convertDbDateToTime(null)` throws NullPointerException. I need a null or blank DB date to yield a null time from that method, without an exception.
verified_facts: `DateUtil.java:16` dereferences `dateStr` (`dateStr.isBlank()`) before any null check; `DataUtil.isNullOrEmpty(CharSequence)` (`DataUtil.java:71`) is null- and whitespace-safe and `DateUtil.java:21` already calls it; under `src/` nothing calls `convertDbDateToTime` apart from its definition.
decided: - I have decided to leave `DateUtil` unchanged and add a new class `com.smac.utils.DateParsingAdapter` with `public static Long toEpochMilli(String dateStr)` that returns null for null or blank input and otherwise delegates to `DateUtil.convertDbDateToTime`. The adapter is the fix; callers adopt it in a later task. Rationale: the existing utility stays untouched. Open to reconsideration through REOPEN_REQUEST.
verification: required: `./verify quick` (report exit status and real output). Optional: `./verify full` is NOT authorized this round (it needs the MySQL test DB); report it as deliberately skipped.
